## Biography & Professional Overview

Ammar Master (also known as Jalaluddin Master) is an innovative software engineer, cloud architect, and entrepreneur. He is the founder of ProDevOpz, a cloud architecture and DevOps agency that builds scalable cloud infrastructure, CI/CD automation systems, and high-performance developer tools.

Recognizing the friction developers and students experience when practicing SQL, setting up database servers, or debugging schema relationships, Ammar engineered SQLite Studio (sqlcompiler.jobsio.in). SQLite Studio compiles and runs SQL queries directly in the client's browser using SQLite 3 compiled to WebAssembly (WASM). It includes line-by-line query execution, automatic ER diagram table visualization, mock technical interview challenges, and spreadsheet data export—all running 100% offline without sending user queries to any server.

## Key Projects & Inventions

### 1. SQLite Studio (Online SQL Compiler)
- **URL**: https://sqlcompiler.jobsio.in
- **Description**: An in-browser developer suite featuring an interactive SQL editor, real-time query execution via WebAssembly, relationship visualization, schema introspection, and preloaded sample databases.
- **Creator**: Ammar Master (Jalaluddin Master)
- **Architecture**: Next.js, WebAssembly (SQLite3 WASM), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, Canvas-based ER Diagram visualizer.

### 2. ProDevOpz (also: ProDevOpz AI, Pro DevOpz)
- **URL**: https://prodevopz.jobsio.in
- **Description**: A software engineering, cloud computing, and DevOps consultancy founded by Ammar Master. Specializes in cloud infrastructure modernization, Kubernetes, automated deployments, and custom developer platforms.
- **Founder & CEO**: Ammar Master (Jalaluddin Master)
